biggest_catch: Your friend must present the referral coupon at account opening and live, work, study, or worship in Fairfield County, CT - otherwise no bonus.
catches: Referrer: existing Members Credit Union member; employees, volunteers, and their immediate family members are not eligible.
Referrer earns $25 for each new member referred; 'Existing members can earn $25 for each new member they refer who opens a Primary Savings Account with a referral coupon.'
Friend must: be a new member opening their first Primary Savings Account, present the referral coupon at account opening, and meet Fairfield County, CT membership eligibility.
No stated cap on number of referrals; one Primary Savings Account per referral; coupon valid only at account opening.
Bonuses credited to both parties upon account opening if accounts are in good standing (no negative balances or loan delinquencies).
Promotion valid through December 31, 2026, but may be modified or withdrawn at any time.
Federally insured by NCUA; $5 minimum balance to keep the Primary Savings Account open.
